definition: GPT4-Assisted Visual Instruction Evaluation, an approach to evaluate visual instruction tuning without the need for human-annotated groundtruth answers and can adapt to diverse instruction formats.
details: GPT4-Assisted Visual Instruction Evaluation, an approach to evaluate visual instruction tuning without the need for human-annotated groundtruth answers and can adapt to diverse instruction formats.

explainer.lead: GAVIE is a way to judge how well models follow visual instructions, using GPT-4 to assist with evaluation. It matters because it removes the need to write a human-approved answer for every test and can handle varied instruction formats.

tiers.eli5: Imagine asking a computer different kinds of questions about a picture, with each question worded differently. GAVIE uses GPT-4 as a helper to check the computer's answers, so a person does not have to write a perfect answer for every question first. This makes it easier to see how well the computer follows directions involving pictures.
tiers.practitioner: Apply GAVIE when evaluating responses from visually instruction-tuned models, especially when test instructions use varied formats. GPT-4 assists the evaluation, avoiding the need to prepare human-annotated ground-truth answers for every case. Treat the results as GPT-4-assisted judgments rather than human-written reference answers.
tiers.paperLevel: Let M be a visually instruction-tuned model and x an instruction in one of several formats; GAVIE evaluates M(x) with GPT-4 assistance, without requiring a human-annotated ground-truth answer y*. It therefore replaces reference-based evaluation with model-assisted judgment. Its judgments remain dependent on GPT-4 as the evaluator.

explainer.example: A model receives an image and the instruction, "Describe the main object, then answer the question in one sentence." Its response is evaluated with GPT-4's assistance, without a human-written ideal answer, and the same approach can accommodate differently worded instructions.

usedIn.name: Visual instruction tuning
usedIn.detail: Evaluating how well tuned models respond to instructions involving visual input.

usedIn.name: Multimodal model evaluation
usedIn.detail: Assessing responses across diverse instruction formats without human-annotated ground-truth answers.

explainer.intuition: Writing an ideal answer for every visual instruction is expensive, and rigid answer matching does not suit varied instruction formats. GAVIE instead uses GPT-4 to help judge model responses without those human-annotated references.
howItWorks: Give a visually instruction-tuned model instructions in the formats being tested.
Collect the model's responses to those visual instructions.
Use GPT-4 to assist in evaluating the responses without human-annotated ground-truth answers.
Apply the same evaluation approach across diverse instruction formats.
explainer.whyItMatters: GAVIE reduces dependence on costly human answer annotation while making visual instruction evaluation adaptable to different prompt formats. This makes it easier to assess instruction-tuned models when a single fixed answer key would be impractical.
misconceptions: GAVIE is an evaluation approach, not a new vision-language model.
GPT-4 assists with judging responses; it is not the model being trained through visual instruction tuning.
